subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the current Sessions-page Group by channel and None modes be considered sufficient for this request, or should OpenClaw add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main covers channel grouping but not the requested merged conversation timeline, and choosing the remaining UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics is a maintainer product decision rather than an automation-safe bug fix.

options.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Sessions-page grouping is the intended Control UI channel surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want the broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Scope Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as canonical and define the separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation and docs update for channel grouping came through steipete's recent Control UI session grouping work.
